messages:
anya: Quick bring-up of ember9b variants for chat+qa. Need routing rec before product sync.

sam: numbers?

anya: Topline:
- ember-9b-int6: p50=78ms p95=180ms QA delta=-0.5pp vs fp1613b throughput~1000 tok/s cost $0.75/1M
- ember-9b-int4: p50=65ms p95=240ms QA delta=-3.1pp throughput~1250 tok/s cost $0.45/1M
- fallback: core-13b-int8 p50=135ms p95=350ms QA delta=-0.2pp cost $1.15/1M

lee: int4 p95 looks bad. KV cold-start?

anya: yep, cold starts on multi-turn. Also some factual hallucination in long summaries.

sam: did you test entropy hijack?

anya: entropy>3.0 -> reroute to 13b. Cuts int4 QA loss by ~0.8pp, cost bump ~12% slice.

lee: recommended split?

anya: propose: 60% int6 default, 30% int4 for short chats (<=70 tokens, history<=150), 10% 13b fallback. Entropy hijack to fallback. Warm-probe cheap-chat buckets to keep KV hot.

sam: blended cost?

anya: ~0.69/1M tokens. Communicate risk: "~0.5-1.2pp expected QA impact vs fp1613b; fallbacks mitigate high-risk traffic."

ops-bot: deploy-canary applied c-202506-07, 1% traffic start=2025-06-07T09:10:00Z

lee: Watch per-route p95, synth-qa delta, entropy hijack rate. Rollback cheap-chat if QA drift >1.5pp.

anya: I'll publish dashboard + 6h runbook and post results here.
